_comment: Specification for the Runpod Serverless endpoint (Option B). NOT created: creating it needs the owner's separate approval. Updated 2026-10-12 after the A40 Pod compatibility PASS. Items under 'unverified' have not been exercised on a real Serverless worker.
name: bhoomi-beta-v1
worker_image_with_adapter: BUILD: deploy/beta/serverless/Dockerfile.worker (FROM the pinned digest above); record the resulting image digest in the approval manifest and worker receipt

engine_evidence.note: This worker image embeds the SAME vLLM build (commit and pipeline) as vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0@sha256:8a69ffad..., which loaded the real checkpoint-160 adapter and made native tool calls on an A40 Pod on 2026-10-12. Worker-specific behaviour (launch arguments, LoRA/template wiring, cold start) is still unverified.

gpu_notes.NVIDIA A40: VERIFIED engine+GPU: GA102 sm_86, 48 GB, CUDA 13.0/13.2 hosts, Secure cloud. Serverless flex price 1.22 USD/h (catalog read 2026-10-12).
gpu_notes.NVIDIA RTX A6000: Same GA102 chip and 48 GB; not run. Stock was NONE on 2026-10-12.
gpu_notes.excluded: RTX 3090 (no CUDA >= 13.0 host available; Community only on CUDA 12.4), RTX 4090/A5000/L4 (not run with this stack).

scaling.idle_timeout_note: 5 s (earlier draft) makes nearly every question pay a full cold start. Measured Pod cold start (container start to ready, eager mode, weights downloaded) was 78 s; at 1.22 USD/h that is ~0.026 USD per cold start versus ~0.020 USD to keep a worker 60 s.

spend_controls: prepaid balance only (no auto-recharge); the operator attests this to billing_monitor.py (MONITOR_AUTOPAY_DISABLED=1) after checking the console
workers_max exactly 1; workers_min exactly 0 (billing_monitor.py verifies both every minute and withholds shutdown_verified otherwise)
relay: approval manifest + <=300 s old provider billing evidence + monthly reservation cap + daily request cap
gateway: per-user and global GPU-second budgets, persistent kill switch, and the relay's persistent pause on any identity mismatch
a restricted/read-only API key for billing_monitor.py (RUNPOD_MONITOR_API_KEY), separate from the key the relay uses to call the endpoint
env_notes: GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION and ENFORCE_EAGER match the configuration that PASSED on the A40 Pod (0.85, eager). A network-volume deployment would use LORA_MODULES path /runpod-volume/bhoomi-ckpt160 and CUSTOM_CHAT_TEMPLATE under the same directory instead.

adapter_delivery.recommended: bake the 8 hash-verified files into an image layer (deploy/beta/serverless/Dockerfile.worker). The image digest then IS the adapter identity: no network volume, no Hugging Face token, immutable by digest. Needs: a private registry account/credential and the 148 MB adapter uploaded to it.
adapter_delivery.alternative: network volume populated once from a temporary Pod (storage billed monthly; identity needs a post-fill sha256 attestation).
adapter_delivery.rejected: Hugging Face private repo: vLLM resolves LoRA repos without a revision pin, so content identity is weaker.

unverified: worker-vllm's launch arguments for LoRA/tool parser/template on this worker (the engine build is verified; the wrapper that launches it is not)
CUSTOM_CHAT_TEMPLATE: the worker README documents it as a template string; whether a file path is honoured must be shown by the first request
response `model` and /openai/v1/models `parent` fields on the worker (the relay refuses anything else)
cold start on Serverless (measured only on a Pod)
A40 availability: stock was LOW on 2026-10-12; a queued request waits for a worker
data_policy: The worker receives only prompts that the Core builds from allowed tool outputs and user questions. It never receives data files, the feedback database or restricted datasets.
